c.title: Governor and Lieutenant Governor
note: Vote for candidates of one party.

c.title: REFERENDUM: DELAWARE COUNTY WATER QUALITY, NATURAL AREAS, AND WILDLIFE HABITAT PROTECTION
c.q: Shall debt in the maximum principal amount of up to $120 million be authorized for purposes of financing land conservation, including protecting drinking water sources, water quality in rivers and creeks, wildlife habitat, conserving trees to protect air quality, conserving wetlands to prevent flooding, providing greenways and parks, protecting natural areas from development, and related costs, to be incurred by the County as debt approved by the voters, requiring public disclosure and annual independent audits?
c.pre: To the voters of Delaware County, Pennsylvania:

c.title: REFERENDUM: BETHEL TOWNSHIP TO AID IN MAINTAINING THE RACHEL KOHL LIBRARY
c.q: Do you favor increasing the annual tax on the assessed value of all taxable real property situated in Bethel Township from .027 mills to .037 mills to aid in maintaining the Rachel Kohl Community Library?
